children: MSC Industrial reported fiscal 2026 revenue of $4.01 billion, up 6.4% from the prior year, while net income rose 11.7% to $222.59 million and diluted EPS increased 11.5% to $3.98. Sales growth was driven mainly by pricing, as volume was slightly lower.
¹ Reported as “Net sales”. ² Reported as “Net income attributable to MSC Industrial”. ³ Reported as “Diluted income per common share”.
Average daily sales increased 6.0%. Core and other customers grew 7.7%, while public sector customers grew 0.3%.
E-commerce, including electronic ordering and vending, accounted for 63.7% of sales, nearly unchanged year over year.
The company expanded its customer support network to 31,078 vending machines and 431 in-plant program locations.
Sales optimization reduced field sales and service headcount, while network initiatives lowered freight costs. Digital-core issues resulted in $43.7 million in impairments.
